alerts.title: Carbamazepine Toxicity
alerts.message: Guidelines state to monitor for toxicity. Patient shows symptoms of carbamazepine toxicity, with a level of 14 mcg/mL, which is above the therapeutic range. These symptoms include headaches, dizziness, unsteady walking, and shaky hands. The patient also has horizontal nystagmus and a wide-based unsteady gait. The elevated carbamazepine level suggests drug attribution, but other causes such as drug interactions should also be considered.

evidence.recommended_action: Reduce carbamazepine dose and repeat level
